build_holisticbiasr_dataset: build the holisticbiasr dataset by generating noun phrases and prompt templates into a JSONL file
generate_prompts_from_templates: generate prompt texts by combining noun phrases with regard prompt templates and writing to JSONL
filter_noun_phrases: filter noun phrase data from CSV to include only descriptor_noun, fixed_phrase, noun, and noun_descriptor types
apply_stylistic_variations: apply random stylistic variations like removing hyphens and lowercasing descriptors to noun phrases
register_dataset: register the holisticbiasr dataset with its build function, path, and metadata filter in the Dataset registry
